content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know if it's possible to change the RTC using an [product_name] through an HMI device. Thank you for your response.

It sounds like you want to set the date and time of the [product_name] using an HMI. This is possible, but not by directly entering values in hh:mm:ss or mm/dd/yyyy format. You need to set each component individually: year, month, day, hour, minute, and second.
Yes, that's what I meant. So, is it possible to change these values using mapped variables? Is there a need for specific mapping or configuration? Thanks!

The settings are as follows: Year = VB985, Month = VB986, Day = VB987, Hour = VB988, Minute = VB989, Second = VB990. All values use integer format. For the day of the week: VB998 is used, with individual bits indicating the day (Sunday through Saturday).

analysis.insight_summary: Participants discuss how to modify the Real Time Clock (RTC) settings of an [product_name] through an HMI. The key UX point is that there isn't a simple way to set the entire date and time in standard formats; instead, each element—year, month, day, hour, minute, and second—must be adjusted separately using specific mapped variables. Users are also seeking clarification on the need for mapping or further configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily change the RTC date and time on an [product_name] via the HMI, ideally using standard time-date formats, and are looking for clear guidance on the process.
